excerpt.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

texts.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
texts.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

label.zh: 真是棒极了。但我们没必要继续在这上面耗费精力了。

texts.en: Continued exploration by the crew of [From.GetName] has revealed the hot water coming from deep within the planet's crust is teeming with microscopic life! What we once thought of as an empty, frozen planet, actually contains a thriving underwater biosphere!

# 神秘热源 / Mysterious Heat

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:688-701` · `events/anomaly_events_4.txt:3985-4056 (3140-3141)`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 2级异常；在冰冻行星上以权重3生成。  
  Level-2 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on frozen planets.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 3140“地下热泉”：热源来自地下热泉。继续 → 行星获“地下海洋”修正（如有采矿资源则清除）与3社会学资源点，30天后 3141“外星生命的深度”（热泉中满是微生物，社会学研究）；或不再投入（凝聚力）。  
  3140 "Heat from Below": hydrothermal springs. Continue → Subterranean Ocean modifier (mining deposits cleared) and +3 society, then 3141 after 30 days (microbial life; society research); or stop (unity).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无随机分支。  
  No random branch.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

- 已核对 Checked：类别与3140/3141。  
  Category and 3140/3141.
